action: Unlock the browser session with the per-launch passphrase
notes: Only unauthenticated /api/v1 operation. Argon2id verification, bounded throttling, generic indistinguishable failures, one-time memory-only browser capability. Covers the locked and throttled-unlock UX states.

action: Read session metadata and discover the supported API version
notes: Publishes api_major and exact contract_version; clients fail closed on mismatch (AC-25). Shows read-only scope in the session chrome.

action: Stop the workspace from the UI
notes: Confirmed in-UI Stop workspace action covering the process-stopped UX state. Modifies no project file, so it stays available in read-only sessions. Invalidates the passphrase verifier, all capabilities, and all in-memory receipts.

action: Serve the static locked bootstrap shell
notes: The unauthenticated bootstrap shell is served outside /api/v1 and contains no project data; from the locked shell the only /api/v1 call available before any capability exists is unlockSession, the sole unauthenticated operation.

action: Bootstrap a machine session from the stdout descriptor
notes: The --machine-session launch prints exactly one sensitive JSON descriptor on stdout (base URL, API version, session ID, capability, mode, process identity) outside /api/v1 with no passphrase prompt; the machine capability then authorizes getSession and the rest of the contract for headless clients (AC-18).

action: Understand project state and configuration
notes: Overview view. Distinguishes setup, invalid, stale, review-required, and completed states with counts that link to exact resources; next_action recommends the next human action. Covers the setup/empty UX state.

action: Browse and inspect registered resources
notes: Policies & Artifacts and Overview views. Read-time hashes and validation state; opaque resource IDs only. Covers loading and refresh UX states via documented reads.

action: Register an existing root-contained file
notes: References without copying. The forge.workspace/1 index changes only through preview/commit; containment violations return the typed resource-containment error (AC-4).

action: Upload bounded bytes to a confirmed root-contained target
notes: At most 10 MiB decoded, inert data validated by role, media type, size, parser, and destination rules before a preview; the source machine path is never sent or retained.

action: Prepare and inspect Markdown-to-OSCAL conversion
notes: Policies & Artifacts view. Shared conversion application service; derived products and their write preview appear only after the bounded operation succeeds; no direct write (AC-6).

action: Run validation and retrieve structured diagnostics
notes: Invalid-input UX state. Stable codes and resource/field pointers from the shared validation services; no terminal parsing; safe in read-only sessions.

action: Review the complete framework control inventory
notes: Framework Scope view. Complete control denominator; controls omitted from the manifest surface as under-review and are never inferred (AC-7).

action: Read and validate the applicability decisions draft
notes: Framework Scope view editor backing. Validates required state, rationale, reviewer, and review-time fields without minting a receipt.

action: Save applicability decisions as a manifest write preview
notes: Full-document put with observed version; the forge.applicability/1 file changes only through commitEffectPreview (M-9, M-13).

action: Regenerate the deterministic gap analysis
notes: Same shared analysis service as the CLI; the regenerated report is written only via its EffectPreview and commit, keeping versioned files authoritative.

action: View the current gap report and its staleness
notes: Overview and Trace & Reports views. Classification counts with input fingerprints; stale flag drives the stale-input UX state (AC-9).

action: Compare policy and framework mapping subjects
notes: Mappings view. Exact resource identity and fingerprints on both sides; absence of a relationship is never converted into a decision (AC-8).

action: Read and validate the mapping decisions draft
notes: Mappings view editor backing. Preserves the positive versus explicit no-relationship distinction through validation.

action: Save mapping decisions as a manifest write preview
notes: Full-document put with observed version; the forge.mapping-manifest/1 file changes only through commitEffectPreview (M-10, M-13).

action: Run mapping collection consistency checks
notes: Synchronous, bounded, read-only compute over the currently committed mapping inputs; stable diagnostic codes.

action: Build the mapping collection model
notes: Bounded operation over the shared mapping service; participation totals and coverage come from the typed result, and the rendered report is written only via its preview and commit.

action: Work the review queue with filters, sorting, and paging
notes: Review Queue view. Stable reason codes in priority order; deterministic cursor traversal that neither duplicates nor omits items for an unchanged version (AC-24).

action: Reconcile review queue counts
notes: Counts by reason code that reconcile to the unfiltered denominator exposed by listReviewQueueItems; every displayed count is navigable via CM-24 (AC-9).

action: Traverse provenance and read bounded source excerpts
notes: Trace & Reports view. Bidirectional traversal from any count or classification to controls, decisions, mapping edges, policy subjects, exact source locations, and fingerprints; excerpts are bounded and escaped; no arbitrary path reads.

action: Inspect an effect preview before confirming
notes: Confirm-dialog evidence: exact target, create/overwrite status, base/target/input hashes, validation diagnostics, semantic summary, escaped text diff, and receipt expiry.

action: Commit the exact previewed bytes
notes: Only write path. One-time receipt plus observed version plus idempotency key; any mismatch, expiry, or reuse rejects without a write (AC-10, AC-11); identical retries return the original result (AC-22). Covers the expired-preview and external-conflict UX states.

action: Query bounded operations
notes: Read-available, session-scoped operation resources created by conversion, analysis, build, export, and commit requests. State plus typed result determines whether a write committed after disconnect or timeout (AC-23).

action: Cancel a running operation safely
notes: Cancel UX state. Cooperative cancellation that never leaves a partial write; a committed effect is reported truthfully in the terminal result (AC-17).

action: Prepare a redacted static report export
notes: Trace & Reports view. Self-contained static HTML from the same versioned report model with the strict-default redaction profile; export bytes are written only via preview and commit.

action: Download a committed export
notes: Reading a committed export is a download of inert, escaped content with a safe filename and content type; available only after the commit operation succeeded; no remote publish.

action: Enforce read-only launch mode
notes: Every mutation returns the typed read-only-session error with no file change (AC-2), covering the permission-denied UX state; all read operations in CM-02, CM-06, CM-07, CM-11 through CM-13, CM-16 through CM-18, CM-20, CM-22 through CM-25, and CM-30 keep working.

action: Render loading, refresh, and empty states from documented reads
notes: Loading, automatic refresh, and empty states must poll documented operations only; no undocumented request may exist (AC-19).

action: Recover from errors, conflicts, and lost responses
notes: Error and retry UX states: typed retryable codes, version-conflict carrying the current version, and idempotent retry after response loss (AC-21, AC-22).

action: Expose machine-readable status for accessible announcements
notes: The API supplies stable states, counts, and reason codes so the UI can announce status and errors to assistive technology; WCAG 2.2 AA conformance itself is a UI-layer obligation documented outside the API contract.

action: Drive the complete workspace through the published API
notes: US-13 completeness entry: a write-capable session (browser or machine) can perform the entire golden path with only these operations (AC-18). This entry intentionally lists every operationId as the exhaustive coverage denominator for CI.

action: Initialize an explicit applicability decision manifest
notes: Explicit registered Catalog selection; current pins and inventory; no inferred scope decisions or reviewers. Preview and commit one new file, then register separately.

action: Initialize an explicit mapping decision manifest
notes: Explicit registered Catalog selection; current pins and inventory; no inferred relationships or decisions. Preview and commit one new file, then register separately. Mapping review metadata and at least one reviewed relationship are human supplied.
